projects.title: Impact of Non-Gaussian Noise on LDPC Performance
projects.text: MATLAB simulations of BER vs. SNR for LDPC-coded 64-QAM under AWGN and Student's t-distributed noise. LDPC codes stay robust under Gaussian noise but need higher SNR in non-Gaussian environments.
